SHOPCART PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: 1 March 2026. Version 3.1.

ShopCart Retail Private Limited operates shopcart.in. We are the Data Fiduciary. Contact our
privacy team at privacy@shopcart.in.

WHAT WE COLLECT
We collect your name, email address, mobile number, delivery address, payment method token and
order history. We collect this to process your orders, arrange delivery, handle returns and
provide customer support.

CONSENT
By continuing to use the site you agree to our collection of your personal data for all purposes
described in this policy, including marketing.

SHARING
We share your personal data with logistics partners, payment gateways and analytics providers.
We may share your data with other partners from time to time. We do not sell your personal data.

COOKIES
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to remember your cart and to measure
advertising performance. Third party scripts from advertising partners run on our site.

SECURITY
We take security seriously and use industry standard measures to protect your information.

RETENTION
We retain your data for as long as necessary.

YOUR CHOICES
You can email us at privacy@shopcart.in if you have questions about your information.

CHILDREN
Our services are not directed at individuals under the age of eighteen.
